page.title: Our Technology
page.subtitle: Integrated optical metrology technology for precision wavefront measurement and advanced optical analysis.
page.description: SpotOptics combines Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensors, SenSoft analysis software, precision optical systems, and application-specific metrology expertise to deliver accurate and reliable optical measurements for research, industrial testing, and advanced optical engineering.

hero.heading: Technology that transforms optical measurements into actionable insight
hero.text: Our integrated technology ecosystem combines precision wavefront sensing, advanced optical analysis software, and application-specific metrology systems to deliver high-accuracy measurements across research, manufacturing, telescope alignment, lens testing, and imaging applications.

technology_pillars.title: Core technology pillars
technology_pillars.description: Four integrated technologies form the foundation of every SpotOptics measurement solution.

items.title: Shack-Hartmann wavefront sensing
items.description: High-resolution wavefront measurement using lenslet-array based Shack-Hartmann technology for optical characterization, alignment, and performance evaluation.

items.title: Advanced optical analysis
items.description: SenSoft software provides acquisition, visualization, contour mapping, spot diagrams, Zernike analysis, and optical diagnostics.

items.title: Precision optical metrology
items.description: Research-grade measurement solutions for lenses, mirrors, telescopes, imaging systems, and complex optical assemblies.

items.title: Calibration and optimization
items.description: Precision calibration, alignment verification, and optical system optimization for laboratory and industrial environments.

software_platform.title: SenSoft software platform
software_platform.subtitle: Powerful software. Smarter optical results.
software_platform.description: SenSoft is a complete software environment for wavefront acquisition, visualization, analysis, diagnostics, and measurement reporting. It connects directly with Shack-Hartmann sensors and provides comprehensive optical performance evaluation.

products.title: Technology-enabled products
products.description: Our products are built around a common technology platform that integrates precision optics, wavefront sensing, motorized positioning, and advanced software analysis.
